---
description: "Hands a request to the Squad Federation Coordinator, which routes it to one or more named sub-squads and runs each scoped to its own squad root"
agent: Squad Federation Coordinator
argument-hint: "request=... [squad=<name>] [init] [promote] [watch=...] [profile=...] [discovery=quick|standard|deep|skip] [tier=...] [owner=...] [mode=autonomous|autopilot]"
---

# Squad Federation

## Inputs

* ${input:request}: (Required) The work for the federation this turn, from the user prompt or conversation.
* ${input:squad}: (Optional) The registered sub-squad to route this request to (for example, `squad=product` or `squad=azure`). Overrides meta-routing for the turn; when omitted, the coordinator matches the request against `meta-routing.md`.
* ${input:init}: (Optional) When present, triggers Federation Init Mode so the coordinator proposes, confirms, and creates a set of named sub-squads before routing the request. When a `federation.md` already exists, the same flag runs Federation Expansion Mode instead — proposing, confirming, and adding one (or more) new sub-squad(s) to the existing federation before routing.
* ${input:promote}: (Optional) When present on an existing single-squad project (a top-level `team.md` exists and no `federation.md`), triggers Federation Promotion Mode, which adopts the existing squad into a federation as its first sub-squad — moving its state and its pre-promotion deliverables intact — before routing the request.
* ${input:watch}: (Optional) Watch Mode provenance supplied by an event-triggered run — the event `source`, `ref`, `eventId`, `actor`, and the derived sub-squad name (for example `watch="source=issue ref=owner/repo#123 eventId=issues:987 actor=octocat sub=issue-123"`). When present, the coordinator runs Watch Mode Bootstrap Mode: it initializes, auto-promotes, or auto-expands the federation as the repository state requires, targets the event's own sub-squad, and runs that sub-squad's autopilot scoped to `members/<name>/`.
* ${input:profile}: (Optional) A profile hint forwarded to a sub-squad's Init when that sub-squad has no squad yet.
* ${input:discovery}: (Optional) The discovery-gate depth (`quick`, `standard`, `deep`, or `skip`) forwarded to every `product` or `full` sub-squad the turn starts; sub-squads on other profiles ignore it. The federation asks the discovery question at most once and applies the answer per qualifying sub-squad, so this input settles it for the whole turn. Ignored on a Watch Mode or otherwise unattended run.
* ${input:tier}: (Optional) A model-tier hint (`fast` or `default`) forwarded to the selected sub-squad's coordinator run to override cost-first defaults for this turn.
* ${input:owner}: (Optional) A `Member Name` forwarded to the selected sub-squad's coordinator run to pick a specific named member when two rows share the same `Role`.
* ${input:mode}: (Optional) The autonomy mode (`autonomous` or `autopilot`). With a single `squad=` target, or with `mode=autonomous`, it is forwarded to the selected sub-squad's coordinator run. With `mode=autopilot` and **no** `squad=` target, the coordinator runs the federation-level autopilot meta-pipeline across the meta-routing-selected sub-squads per `.github/instructions/squad/squad-federation-autopilot.instructions.md`. When omitted, the sub-squad uses the standard interactive tiers.

## Requirements

1. Hand `${input:request}` to the Squad Federation Coordinator and let its per-turn protocol classify the request to one or more sub-squads and run each scoped to its own squad root.
2. When `${input:squad}` is provided, route the request to that registered sub-squad (escalate when the name is not in `federation.md`); otherwise let the coordinator match `meta-routing.md`.
3. When `${input:init}` is present, or when the project has no `.copilot-tracking/squad/federation.md`, let the coordinator run Federation Init Mode (propose → confirm → create) before routing, per `.github/instructions/squad/squad-federation.instructions.md`; when a `federation.md` already exists, `${input:init}` (or an add-a-sub-squad request) runs Federation Expansion Mode (propose → confirm → create → register) to add a sub-squad to the existing federation instead of rebuilding. When `${input:promote}` is present, or when a top-level `team.md` exists with no `federation.md` and the user asks to move to a federation, let the coordinator run Federation Promotion Mode (propose → confirm → migrate → seed → route) to adopt the existing single squad as the first sub-squad instead of a from-scratch Init, per the *Promotion: Single Squad → Federation* contract in the same file.
4. Forward `${input:profile}`, `${input:discovery}`, `${input:tier}`, `${input:owner}`, and `${input:mode}` as pass-through hints to the selected sub-squad's coordinator run. When `${input:discovery}` is omitted, at least one selected sub-squad is seeded from `product` or `full`, and the discovery gate's conditions hold, let the coordinator ask the discovery question **once at the federation level** and apply the answer to every qualifying sub-squad, rather than asking once per sub-squad; sub-squads on other profiles run unchanged, per `.github/instructions/squad/squad-discovery-gate.instructions.md`. When `${input:mode}` is `autopilot` and no `${input:squad}` target is given, let the coordinator run the federation-level autopilot meta-pipeline (federation plan → ordered sub-squad autopilot inner runs → aggregated federation gates → one consolidated final-outcome validation) per `.github/instructions/squad/squad-federation-autopilot.instructions.md`; a single `${input:squad}` target keeps the forward-only behavior.
5. When `${input:watch}` is present, let the coordinator run Watch Mode Bootstrap Mode ahead of any classification, per *Event-Scoped Sub-Squads (Federation Bootstrap)* in `.github/instructions/squad/squad-watch-mode.instructions.md`: derive the sub-squad name from structural event metadata only, bootstrap the federation (init, auto-promote then expand, or auto-expand), reuse the sub-squad on matching provenance, escalate on a human-owned name collision, and then run that sub-squad's standard single-squad autopilot scoped to `members/<name>/`. An explicit `${input:squad}` target overrides the event sub-squad and creates nothing.
6. Let the coordinator own the registry, meta-routing, and two-level state; it reads `.copilot-tracking/squad/{federation.md,meta-routing.md,state.json}`, seeds them and each `members/<name>/` sub-squad on first run through Federation Init Mode, and persists federation-level decisions and history through the Squad Scribe while each sub-squad persists its own state under its root.
